articles.title: Moody's holds steady on France's credit rating as country grapples with turmoil and higher yields
articles.summary: Moody's opted to maintain its credit rating on France as the country contended with a week of civil unrest and rising political risk. Investors were anticipating Moody's rating decision as France, the second-largest economy in the euro zone, contended with civil unrest and a sharp surge in bond yields. This week, the nation's 10-year bond yield surpassed 5% for the first time since 2002.
